name: Light Fades Twice Lizalfos + Chilfos PRIVATE TEST
author: Dusklight community mods
description: 0.13.1 CHILFOS01 FIX01 over Lizalfos FIX05 0.12.5 (Lizalfos unchanged). The Chilfos (E_KK) fights with four learnable combos of diagonal slashes and thrusts (one ends with a backstep, a real spear throw and a fast restore), blocks and adaptively parries with native sword rebound and counters, has 340 HP and 0..100 posture. Below 100 posture Link's sword and Shield Attack never stagger it or cut its combos; at 100 it staggers for 3 s: a new sword hit, or a Shield Attack then Helm Splitter, kills it natively. HUMAN_RUNTIME_PENDING. Replace only this ID; rollback 0.13.0 or 0.12.5.
